g.text: Paired component contributions across five seeds
Difference = model after arrow minus control before arrow, paired within seed and identical cohort.
Diamonds and horizontal whiskers: mean ± sample SD (ddof=1). Colors: individual seeds; vertical offsets only prevent overlap.
Fixed, previously observed splits; SD reflects training stochasticity, not dataset uncertainty. No significance claims.
